business_question: Can asset history and condition data available up to an observation cutoff be used to evaluate future failure risk or time-to-event while preserving censoring and temporal order?

primary_task.name: future_failure_risk_or_time_to_event_readiness
primary_task.description: Define whether a dataset can support horizon-risk, RUL, or survival-style reliability analysis without leaking future information.

secondary_tasks.name: remaining_useful_life_regression
secondary_tasks.description: Remaining cycle or time target with strict separation of target construction and prediction-time features.

secondary_tasks.name: recurrent_event_analysis
secondary_tasks.description: Repeated failures after maintenance or replacement, with explicit clock reset policy.

secondary_tasks.name: maintenance_decision_support
secondary_tasks.description: Offline prioritization support only; no causal maintenance-effect claim.

secondary_tasks.name: degradation_trajectory_analysis
secondary_tasks.description: Trajectory summaries that only use measurements available before the prediction origin.

unit_of_analysis.name: asset_observation
unit_of_analysis.description: One row should represent an asset at an observation time or cycle.

asset_id.description: Stable identifier for an asset or unit under observation.

component_id.description: Component identifier when failures are component-specific.

fleet_id.description: Fleet, site, or operating population identifier for external or subgroup holdout.

operating_regime.description: Known operating condition or regime; may be metadata or validation group, not hidden asset identity.

observation_timestamp.description: Timestamp when covariates are observed, if the dataset is time-indexed.

observation_cycle.description: Cycle or usage counter when timestamp is absent or secondary.

prediction_origin.description: Cutoff time or cycle defining what is known to the model.

prediction_horizon.description: Future horizon for binary risk labels, such as 7 days, 30 days, or N cycles.

event_timestamp.description: Observed failure or terminal event time when available.

event_indicator.description: Binary event flag where 1 indicates observed event and 0 indicates no observed event at the relevant horizon or endpoint.

censoring_type.description: Right, interval, administrative, informative-risk, or other censoring category.

censoring_timestamp.description: Last observation or administrative end time for censored assets.

failure_mode.description: Failure mode or competing event class when known before analysis.

maintenance_type.description: Maintenance action type; post-diagnosis actions are not prediction-time features.

repair_replacement_policy.description: Defines whether repair resets the reliability clock, preserves age, or creates a new asset record.

degradation_features.policy: Only values available at or before prediction_origin may be used.

dynamic_covariates.policy: Rolling features must be fit from past windows only.

label_availability_time.policy: Labels must be tied to an event or censoring time and not used as prediction-time features.

delayed_outcome.policy: Inspection or teardown labels assigned after diagnosis are outcomes or metadata, not features.

duplicates.policy: Exact duplicates and duplicated trajectories are reported; source rows are not silently dropped.

missingness.policy: Missingness is summarized by asset and time; preprocessing must be fit on training partitions only.

outliers.policy: Outliers are flagged, not deleted, unless a documented source-quality rule requires exclusion.

temporal_ordering.policy: Observation timestamps or cycles must be monotonic within asset for time-aware validation.

asset_split.policy: Asset-disjoint validation is primary evidence for unseen-asset generalization.

time_split.policy: Forward chronological validation is primary evidence for future prediction within known populations.

combined_asset_time_validation.policy: Combined future holdout on unseen assets is strongest evidence when feasible.

train_only_preprocessing.policy: Imputation, scaling, smoothing, filtering, feature selection, and normalization statistics must be fit on training data only.

censoring_handling.policy: Do not claim survival readiness unless event and censoring definitions are available and evaluation is censoring-aware.

competing_risk.policy: Distinct failure modes should not be collapsed without documenting claim scope.

recurrent_event.policy: Repeated events require explicit repair/replacement and clock reset semantics.

privacy.policy: Do not commit private maintenance logs, asset identifiers, or raw operational records unless explicitly public and redistributable.

claim_scope.within_known_asset_interpolation: Only supported by within-asset temporal validation.
claim_scope.future_known_asset_prediction: Requires forward validation with past-only features.
claim_scope.unseen_fleet_site_regime_generalization: Requires explicit fleet, site, or regime holdout.

metrics_contract.policy: Metrics must match task and censoring structure; censored samples must not be ignored with ordinary regression metrics.

prohibited_features: remaining useful life as prediction-time feature
stop_conditions: label only constructible with unresolved leakage
primary task overlaps an existing battery case study without additional methodological value
